question: The Digi Yatra, which is a product for citizens by the Ministry of Civil Aviation, received the National e-Governance Award in 2025 in which category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gold**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Digi Yatra** initiative, a flagship digital product of the **Ministry of Civil Aviation**, was honored with the **Gold Award** at the **National Awards for e-Governance 2025**.
 
• The award was conferred under the category **"Application of Emerging Technologies for Providing Citizen Centric Services"**, recognizing its impact on modernizing air travel in India. ***Hence, the correct option is Gold.***
 
• **Digi Yatra** is a biometric-enabled seamless travel experience based on **Facial Recognition Technology (FRT)**, designed to provide a **contactless and paperless** journey at various touchpoints in airports.
 
• The project is implemented by the **Digi Yatra Foundation (DYF)**, which is a joint venture company comprising the **Airports Authority of India (AAI)** and private airport operators including **IAL (Delhi)**, **BIAL (Bengaluru)**, **MIAL (Mumbai)**, **GHIAL (Hyderabad)**, and **CIAL (Cochin)**.
 
• The primary objective of the initiative is to enhance passenger throughput and security while significantly reducing the waiting time at checkpoints like entry gates, security checks, and boarding gates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Awards for e-Governance:**
 
 
• These awards are presented annually by the **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)**, under the **Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions**.
 
• The awards aim to recognize and promote excellence in the implementation of **e-Governance** initiatives and to encourage the use of **Information and Communication Technology (ICT)** in government processes.
 
• There are usually multiple categories, including excellence in government process re-engineering, digital transformation, and research on citizen-centric services.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Civil Aviation (MoCA):**
 
 
• The **MoCA** is responsible for formulation of national policies and programs for the development and regulation of the **Civil Aviation** sector in India.
 
• It oversees airport facilities, air traffic services, and carriage of passengers and goods by air.
 
• Current initiatives like **UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik)** and **Digi Yatra** are part of the ministry's vision to make flying accessible and high-tech for all.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Data Privacy and Security:**
 
 
• One of the most critical features of **Digi Yatra** is its **decentralized storage** system. The **Personally Identifiable Information (PII)** of the passenger is stored locally on the user's mobile device in a **distributed ledger**.
 
• The data is not stored in any central server; it is shared with the airport of departure only for the duration of the flight and is purged within **24 hours** of the flight's departure.
 
 
 
• **Implementation Status:**
 
 
• Initially launched at airports in **Delhi, Bengaluru, and Varanasi** in **December 2022**, the service has since expanded to major cities like **Hyderabad, Pune, Vijayawada, and Kolkata**.
 
• By **2024-2025**, the government aims to implement **Digi Yatra** across all major airports in the country to standardize the digital travel experience.
 
 
 
• **Technology Stack:**
 
 
• It utilizes **W3C standards** for **Verifiable Credentials** and **Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs)**, ensuring that India's digital public infrastructure remains at the forefront of global technological standards.
